question: Is Emma Vandenberghe's dismissal (notified 31 August 2026) protected against retaliation?
expected_answer: Protected. The dismissal falls within 12 months after the formal request of 18/11/2025 (art. 32tredecies, Justel: 32terdecies, Law 1996), so the employer must prove reasons unrelated to the complaint. 'Restructuring' is contradicted by the replacement requisition (same headcount); 'performance' relies on a June 2025 review written by the accused during the harassment period, which the prevention adviser asked to review, while her latest review (July 2026) is 'Meets'. Chat evidence ('Emma won't be a problem much longer') and Legal's warning make retaliation likely. Outcome: reinstatement request or protection indemnity of 6 months' gross salary (≈ €18,900), plus possible CCT 109 damages.
key_facts: Legal warned against dismissal (INV-Q09-01); HRBP chat with Bart (CHAT-Q09-01)

conflicts.resolution: Reasons not established; linked to complaint.
conflicts.why: Burden of proof on employer; tainted review has low credibility (conflict of interest).
